title: nombre completo
reference_query:
SELECT
    first_name || ' ' || last_name  AS nombre_completo,
    email                           AS correo,
    country                         AS pais
FROM customers
WHERE country = 'Colombia'
ORDER BY nombre_completo ASC;
notes: Resultados reales precalculados desde el dataset SQLite.

title: productos en rango de precio
reference_query:
SELECT name, price
FROM products
WHERE price BETWEEN 50 AND 200
ORDER BY price ASC;
notes: Resultados reales precalculados desde el dataset SQLite.

title: SELECT + WHERE + ORDER BY + LIMIT + Alias
reference_query:
-- Reporte: Top 20 clientes premium de Latinoamérica más recientes
-- Solicitado por: Valentina Torres para reunión con Marco Jiménez

SELECT
    first_name || ' ' || last_name  AS nombre_completo,
    email                           AS correo,
    country                         AS pais,
    registered_at                   AS registro
FROM customers
WHERE (
      country = 'Argentina'
   OR country = 'Colombia'
   OR country = 'Mexico'
  )
  AND city IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY registered_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
notes: Resultados reales precalculados desde el dataset SQLite.
